name: ci-cd-design
description: Design continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines that automate building, testing, security scanning, and deployment of software to enable fast, safe, and reliable releases.
inputs: release requirements (frequency, approval process, rollback needs)
existing CI/CD (current pipelines and pain points)
outputs: CI/CD strategy document (pipeline architecture, build/test/deploy strategy)
pipeline definitions (CI, CD, release, rollback pipelines)
environment strategy (dev, staging, production, promotion flow)
security and compliance integration (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secrets management)
tool selection (CI/CD platform, security tools, monitoring)
